annotations.title: Pension saving room (jaarruimte) and the tax it saves

description: How much an employee or freelancer in the Netherlands may deposit into an annuity (lijfrente) or pension bank account in 2026 and deduct in Box 1: the jaarruimte from last year's income and factor A, unused room from earlier years (reserveringsruimte), and the tax the remaining room saves.

already_paid.description: Annuity premiums already paid in 2026, euros. Default 0.

factor_a.description: Factor A on the 2025 pension statement (UPO); 0 without an employer pension. Default 0.

last_year_income.description: 2025 income from work or business, euros

this_year_taxable_income.description: 2026 taxable Box 1 income, for the tax saving. Default the same as last year.
